questions.question_text: A die has views (top, front, right) H-G-I and G-J-K. Which letter is opposite J?
questions.explanation: Enumerating proper rotations consistent with both views fixes the opposite pairs H-K, G-L and I-J.
questions.source: Dice 01_ Class Notes.pdf, page 17; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A colour die has views (top, front, right) Pink-Red-Green and Brown-Gray-Pink. Which colour is opposite Pink?
questions.explanation: The two oriented views admit only rotations in which Pink is opposite Orange.
questions.source: Dice 01_ Class Notes.pdf, page 18; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: A die has views (top, front, right) P-S-T and Q-P-R. What is opposite S?
questions.explanation: Across the two views, enumerating the proper cube rotations fixes opposite pairs P-U, Q-T and S-R.
questions.source: Dice 01_ Class Notes.pdf, page 19; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: Two views of a symbol die are (top, front, right) $-*-& and $-#-!. What is opposite #?
questions.explanation: The two oriented positions determine that # and * occupy opposite faces.
questions.source: Dice 01_ Class Notes.pdf, page 21; exam/year not stated

questions.question_text: How many faces does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has six square faces.

questions.question_text: How many corners (vertices) does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has eight vertices.

questions.question_text: How many edges does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has twelve edges.

questions.question_text: How many faces meet at each corner of a cube?
questions.explanation: At every cube vertex, exactly three faces meet.

questions.question_text: A cube has 6 faces and 12 edges. How many face-edge incidences are there?
questions.explanation: Each of the six faces has four edges, so the total incidence count is 6×4=24; each physical edge belongs to two faces.

questions.question_text: How many face diagonals are there across all six faces of a cube?
questions.explanation: Each square face has two diagonals, so six faces have 6×2=12 face diagonals.

questions.question_text: On a standard die, which number is opposite 2?
questions.explanation: Standard die opposites sum to 7; 7−2=5.

questions.question_text: On a standard die, which number is opposite 4?
questions.explanation: Standard die opposites sum to 7; 7−4=3.

questions.question_text: On a standard die, 1 is opposite 6 and 2 is opposite 5. Which number is opposite 3?
questions.explanation: The remaining standard pair is 3 and 4.

questions.question_text: On a standard die, what is the sum of the numbers on opposite faces?
questions.explanation: A standard die has opposite pairs 1–6, 2–5 and 3–4; each pair sums to 7.

questions.question_text: Three opposite pairs on a standard die are known. If the visible faces are 1, 2 and 3, which number cannot be adjacent to 1?
questions.explanation: The standard rule fixes 1 opposite 6; every other face is adjacent to 1.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('E', 'D', 'B'), ('F', 'C', 'B')]. Which face is opposite A?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for A: B.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('K', 'J', 'H'), ('L', 'I', 'H')]. Which face is opposite H?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for H: G.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('Black', 'Yellow', 'Blue'), ('White', 'Green', 'Blue')]. Which face is opposite Red?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for Red: Blue.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('*', '&', '#'), ('$', '%', '#')]. Which face is opposite %?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for %: &.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('Q', 'P', 'N'), ('R', 'O', 'N')]. Which face is opposite N?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for N: M.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('Rain', 'Cloud', 'Moon'), ('Wind', 'Star', 'Moon')]. Which face is opposite Star?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for Star: Cloud.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('W', 'V', 'T'), ('X', 'U', 'T')]. Which face is opposite T?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for T: S.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('Five', 'Four', 'Two'), ('Six', 'Three', 'Two')]. Which face is opposite Two?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for Two: One.

questions.question_text: Oriented views (top, front, right) of one cube are [('Birch', 'Elm', 'Pine'), ('Cedar', 'Ash', 'Pine')]. Which face is opposite Oak?
questions.explanation: All four triples must fit one fixed cube. Enumerating the 24 proper rotations gives a single opposite for Oak: Pine.

questions.question_text: From the oriented views [('e', 'd', 'b'), ('f', 'c', 'b')], which pair of faces cannot share an edge?
questions.explanation: The cube model fixes a opposite b; opposite faces do not share an edge.

questions.question_text: Four oriented views (top, front, right) are [('P', 'O', 'M'), ('Q', 'N', 'M')]. What is the only face that can be opposite M?
questions.explanation: The four views are consistent under proper cube rotations and determine M opposite L.

questions.question_text: Four oriented views (top, front, right) are [('E', 'D', 'B'), ('F', 'C', 'B')]. Which face is opposite D, given the four oriented views?
questions.explanation: The four views are consistent under proper cube rotations and determine D opposite C.

questions.question_text: Four oriented views (top, front, right) are [('Blue', 'Green', 'Orange'), ('Violet', 'Yellow', 'Orange')]. Which colour lies opposite Yellow?
questions.explanation: The four views are consistent under proper cube rotations and determine Yellow opposite Green.

questions.question_text: Four oriented views (top, front, right) are [('/', '=', '?'), ('~', '+', '?')]. Which symbol is opposite +?
questions.explanation: The four views are consistent under proper cube rotations and determine + opposite =.

questions.question_text: Four oriented views (top, front, right) are [('a', 'Z', 'X'), ('b', 'Y', 'X')]. Which face is opposite X?
questions.explanation: The four views are consistent under proper cube rotations and determine X opposite W.
